City of Chicago
                                                                       O2021-749
                             Office of the City Clerk
                            Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                  2/26/2021
Sponsor(s):                    Cardenas (12)
Type:                          Ordinance
Title:                         Zoning Reclassification Map No. 6-1 at 2834-2858 S Troy St
                               and 2801-2859 S Troy St
Cornmittee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                                                                       City Council 2.24.21
                                                     Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, & Building Standards




                                   ORDINANCE



B E IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all ofthe RS2, Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District and M2-3, Light Industry District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No 6-1 in the area bounded by

       West 28th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Troy Street; West
       30th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Troy Street; a line 264
       feet north of and parallel to West 30"" Street; South Troy Street; and the
       southeasterly line of the abandoned INRY right-of-way

to those of a RT4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and approval.




                                             George Cardenas
                                             Alderman, 12th Ward




Common Address:
2834-58 8 Troy St
2801-59 S Troy St
